scenarios.title: Pricing review
lines: Okay, let's settle pricing for the Pro plan today.
We looked at three options: ten, twelve and fifteen dollars per seat.
Fifteen dollars tested badly. Churn in the survey group roughly doubled above twelve dollars.
So twelve dollars per seat per month it is. Everyone agree?
Agreed. Priya here, I'd also like a fourteen day free trial instead of seven.
Fine, fourteen day trial. Decision made.
Marcus will update the pricing page by Friday the 14th.
And I'll get legal to review the trial terms before we publish.
We should revisit annual discounts on March 3rd, not now.
scenarios.notes_final:
# Pricing
- **decide Pro price**
- trial length?

# Next steps
- legal review

scenarios.title: API outage retro
lines: Quick recap: the API was down for 47 minutes on Tuesday starting at 2:10 pm.
Root cause was an expired TLS certificate on the internal load balancer.
Why didn't we get alerted before it expired?
The expiry alert went to an email list nobody reads anymore.
Decision: certificate expiry alerts move to PagerDuty, starting this week.
Kim will automate renewal with cert-manager.
I'll write the public postmortem by Friday.
We should also audit the other 12 certificates this week.
scenarios.notes_final:

- outage, **cert expired**

# Fixes
- alerting
- renewal
